name: spotifast
title: Spotifast
description: Control Spotifast, the native Spotify client: play, skip, seek, volume, shuffle, repeat, liked songs and Spotify Connect devices, with the playing track in the menu bar.
author: Seigiard

preferences.name: binaryPath
preferences.title: Spotifast Binary
preferences.description: Path to the Spotifast command. Leave empty to find it in Spotifast.app or on the PATH.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Menu Bar Player
commands.subtitle: Spotifast
commands.description: Show the playing track in the menu bar, with playback controls.

preferences.name: showTrackTitle
preferences.label: Show track title in the menu bar
preferences.description: When off, the menu bar shows only the icon.

commands.name: volume-up
commands.title: Increase Volume
commands.subtitle: Spotifast
commands.description: Raise the volume, 10 percent unless given.

commands.name: volume-down
commands.title: Decrease Volume
commands.subtitle: Spotifast
commands.description: Lower the volume, 10 percent unless given.

commands.name: set-volume
commands.title: Set Volume
commands.subtitle: Spotifast
commands.description: Set the volume to a percentage.

commands.name: cycle-repeat
commands.title: Cycle Repeat
commands.subtitle: Spotifast
commands.description: Step through repeat off, repeat all and repeat one.

commands.name: toggle-like
commands.title: Like / Unlike Track
commands.subtitle: Spotifast
commands.description: Save the playing track to Your Library, or remove it.

commands.name: devices
commands.title: Switch Device
commands.subtitle: Spotifast
commands.description: Move playback to another Spotify Connect device.

commands.name: open-spotifast
commands.title: Open Spotifast
commands.subtitle: Spotifast
commands.description: Bring the Spotifast window forward, starting the app if it is not running.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
